name: csv-query
description: Query CSV data with structured filter, sort, select, and aggregate operations.

path.description: Path to a local CSV file to query. Provide either path or csv_text.

csv_text.description: Raw CSV content to query directly. Provide either csv_text or path.

select.description: Subset of columns to keep in the returned rows.

items.description: Name of a CSV column to include in the output.

filter.description: Filter conditions applied before grouping, sorting, and limiting.

items.description: A filter object with at least column, op, and value fields.
A sort object with column and optional direction fields.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return after all other operations.

group_by.description: Columns to group by before computing aggregations.

items.description: Name of a CSV column to group rows by.

aggregations.description: Aggregate computations to run over the filtered rows or groups.

items.description: An aggregation object such as count, sum, avg, min, or max.

ok.description: True when the CSV query completed successfully.

columns.description: Column names present in the returned rows.

rows.description: Query result rows after filters, grouping, sorting, and selection.

items.description: One result row represented as a JSON object.

row_count.description: Number of rows returned in the result set.

summary.description: Summary information about the query, such as grouping metadata or aggregate results.

ok.description: False when the query failed validation or execution.

error.description: Structured error returned by the tool.
